newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan shares firm but lack bond and lira sparkle.
newsitem.headline: Milan shares firm but lack bond and lira sparkle.

text.p: Italian shares ended higher on Wednesday but failed to show the sparkling performance of domestic bonds and the lira which both hit new highs on optimism about Italy joining a new European single currency.

They added that the performance of the share market was a little disappointing with LIFFE BTP futures hitting new contract highs and the lira at the highest for two years. Even the overseas share picture was positive with Wall Street firm and London FTSE 100 index sailing through the key 4,000 level.
The all-share Mibtel index rose 0.69 percent at 10,14lationary pressures in the UK and U.S. have provided the backdrop for the market's rise in recent days.
